name: Stats-band-lockup
purpose: A labelled, responsive row of stat tiles — the section-heading + auto-fill board shape Template-dashboard.reference.html already hand-rolls for its own KPI section, drawn here as its own reusable lock-up. Composed ENTIRELY from Layout-utilities, Stat-card, Kpi-tile and Cards' arrow-link — no new molecules (per this brief's own do-not-rule instruction). Itinerary row 119 (Layer 2, NO-ARTEFACT-CLASS at mint; PROPOSED here, not ruled).

props.name: arrangement
props.$note: Three arrangement variants: A heading + 3-tile Stat-card board, B heading + 4-tile Kpi-tile board with sparklines, C heading + trailing View-all action + 4-tile Stat-card board. VARIANTS-axis prop (s142-D1 class C6).

props.name: minTileWidth
props.$note: 180 in the dense Kpi-tile arrangement, 240 for Stat-card — matches each tile's own gated .board recipe.

variants.name: heading-only
variants.use: Section heading + a 3-tile Stat-card board — the default, matching Template-dashboard's own KPI section.

variants.name: heading-kpi
variants.use: Section heading + a 4-tile Kpi-tile board with sparklines — a dense band that shows trend shape, not just the number.

variants.name: heading-action
variants.use: Section heading + a trailing 'View all' link + a wider board — for a band that is a preview of a longer list elsewhere.

tokens.heading: canon/type.css .t-cm-section-label composite, the same idiom Template-dashboard uses
tokens.action-link: text/default + primary/background/default (tip) via Cards.reference.html's a.arrow, unmodified
tokens.board: Layout-utilities .l-grid (repeat(auto-fill, minmax(min(240px,100%),1fr))), the recipe Stat-card/Kpi-tile's own .board already hand-rolls
tokens.tiles: Stat-card / Kpi-tile markup, tokens and manifest, fully unmodified — including Kpi-tile's own declared two-seat colour question, inherited not resolved
tokens.$note: Every token above resolves through the ATOM's own manifest; this organism binds nothing new beyond the .sb-head arrangement row.

responsive.$status: PROPOSED at #210 wave-6 (not ruled) — auto-fill collapse (4→2→1 columns) verified in a real browser at 3 widths, driven not merely asserted.
responsive.rule: The board is Layout-utilities' own .l-grid, unmodified — no container-type of its own (WAVE-5 LESSON 3: it measures the enclosing page/container, exactly as Stat-card/Kpi-tile's own demo pages do). The `.sb-head` row wraps the heading above the trailing action at narrow widths via ordinary flex-wrap.
responsive.$note: s210-D3 discipline: the band declares no width of its own.

mustNotNeighbour: A chart making the identical claim in the same view (Stat-card's own antiPattern, inherited)
commonPatterns: account summary preview band with a View-all link

accessibility.structure: A <section aria-labelledby> landmark names the whole band from its own <h2>; each tile keeps its own role="group"+aria-label per Stat-card/Kpi-tile's contract, unmodified.
accessibility.focus: The trailing arrow-link (arrangement C) keeps Cards' own :focus-visible box-shadow treatment; tiles are passive (no focusable content) exactly as their source atoms declare.

antiPatterns: Re-drawing the section heading, grid or tile CSS instead of composing the existing atom
A new molecule where Stat-card or Kpi-tile already covers the need (explicit do-not-rule for this row)
Resolving Kpi-tile's inherited fill-seat/ink-seat colour question locally — that binding is Dave's, not this lock-up's
A container-type declared on .l-grid itself instead of leaving the page/container to measure it
